integrity: Proof reconstructed for all B>0,m>1. Rational checks supplement rather than replace the analytic proof. Priority and external validation are unresolved.
scientific_limitations: Section-conditioned original-time first entrance to the specific four-cycle point only; not a full-plane statistic, and not a theorem about perturbed oscillators or the generalized nonzero-feedback family. The 2023 Poincare map was known; the roof-time/statistical and critical laws are the asserted extension. The 2015 foundational article was inspected from its public abstract only; equivalent prior expressions remain possible.
title: Exact transient clock and two-scale critical slowing in a max-plus negative-feedback oscillator
